wikitext:
{{UI Tips}}<!--
FOR MAINTAINERS: PLEASE REMEMBER:
* When adding new items on the main menu:
** Add it in the first TWO menus.
   First one: Replace all buy/sell prices with //&7Buy price: &6# coins/&7Sell price: &6# coins//&eClick to view product!
   Second one: Replace all buy/sell prices with //&7Buy price: &6# coins/&8# in # offers/&8# insta-buys in 7d//&7Sell price: &6# coins/&8# in # orders/&8# insta-sells in 7d//&eClick to view product!
* When preparing sub-menus or adding new items:
** The main menu icon has a number, increase it in the first TWO menus
** The Bazaar Items copied usually have wrong <name>. Check it with the <title>. If you don't know what I mean, here are the labels:
   |m, n=<name>, <link>, <title>, <text>
** Replace all buy/sell prices with //&7Buy price: &6# coins/&7Sell price: &6# coins//&eClick to view details!
** You may copy from |4, 6=Book, bz-orders (sometimes |5, 6 or |6, 6) down, and just change the id. Check the number of rows, it can be 4, 5, or 6 -> change corresponding numbers and preview it
** Note that the line of |5, 3=Chest, bz-inventory is different for each sub-menu
* Linking: Search for "none," in the sub-menus. This is what you should replace them with:
** Link each item to bz-itemview
** Link "Sell Inventory Now" to bz-inventory
** Link "Sell Orders" to bz-orders
* You should preview new things that is added. Always be cautious!

If you update this piece of instruction, please do it on all Bazaar UI subpages.
v.0.0.1
-->
